key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to poll the Claude usage endpoint, in seconds.

key.name: panel-mode
key.description: Which limit to show in the top bar: 'worst' or 'session'.

key.name: show-cost
key.description: Compute session dollar cost locally via ccusage.

key.name: alerts-enabled
key.description: Notify when a limit crosses 90% or 100%.

key.name: cursor-enabled
key.description: Add a Cursor team-spend section using the Cursor Admin API.

key.name: cursor-api-key
key.summary: Cursor Admin API key (legacy / fallback slot)
key.description: The key normally lives in the system keyring (libsecret), not here. This dconf slot only holds it when no Secret Service is available, and pre-keyring values are migrated out of it on first use.

key.name: cursor-key-stamp
key.description: Bumped by the preferences dialog after writing the key to the keyring, so the running extension knows to refresh. Carries no secret.

key.name: show-sessions
key.description: List today's Claude Code sessions, ranked by the tokens they spent, with a click to resume one in a terminal.

key.name: terminal-command
key.summary: Terminal used to resume a session
key.description: Terminal binary to open when a session row is clicked. Empty means autodetect ($TERMINAL, then the usual emulators).

key.name: work-start
key.description: Used to suggest session-ping times that cover the hours actually worked.

key.name: work-end
key.description: Used to suggest session-ping times that cover the hours actually worked.

key.name: history
key.description: JSON map of limit id to recent percentages, so the sparkline survives a restart.
